description: This file defines the ConnectionSignalIllegalException class, which is a custom exception class used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a connection command arrived while a connection operation was already in progress, and provides a fluent Builder API to create instances with specific details.

classes.name: ConnectionSignalIllegalException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a connection command arrives during an ongoing connection operation. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ConnectivityException. It contains constants, private constructors, and static methods for creating instances from JSON.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance with a specified ConnectionId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

inner_classes.name: Builder
inner_classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for fluently constructing ConnectionSignalIllegalException instances. Methods include setting connection ID, operation name, timeout, and illegal signal details.
